about_the_game:
BRIDGE NINE ADVENTURE

Can you survive the Shattered Plains? When tragedy strikes an expedition, a few lucky survivors must make their way home through the chasms of the Shattered Plains. Can this unlikely crew survive the night, uncover secrets of the Lost Radiants, and return to the warcamps?

Bridge Nine is an introductory 1st-level adventure for the Cosmere® Roleplaying Game. For game masters, it provides a series of scenes designed to teach the game’s rules. For players, it serves as a thrilling introduction to the Stormlight™ campaign setting.

This adventure includes adversary profiles and six pre-generated characters. The Stormlight™Handbook is required for play.

  • Designed for one-shot play.

  • Introduces players to the different mechanics of the Cosmere® RPG.

  • Includes 6 pre-generated characters.

Credits: Johnny O’Neal
